slug: 2025-07-10 Zimbabwe Launches Mobile ID Registration Program to Serve Remote Binga Communities

systems.system: mobile identity document registration initiative, Binga
systems.owner: Civil Registry Department with UNICEF and the Embassy of Sweden
systems.tiers: Binga district, 7 to 11 July 2025, reaching Siamusanga village about 160 km from Binga Centre

note: A five-day mobile registration drive for birth certificates and national IDs: a campaign, not an office; the article does not say how the records were made. It cites birth registration coverage of 57% (ZDHS 2023-24).
